note: Realistic filled-in states in the scoring engine's shape. `expected` is computed by `bin/test-personas --update` and verified by `bin/test-personas`. This engine's appropriateness score combines a raw indication-fit score (Axis A.1) with a symptom-frequency / monitor-duration match adjustment (Axis A.2, +1/-1/-3) before banding, so `appropriatenessScore` can exceed the usual 8-for-ideal ceiling (capped at 9).

personas.name: urgent-atrial-fibrillation-detection-7-day-weekly-matched-presyncope-moderate-priority

personas.name: redirect-palpitations-24-hour-rare-frequency-mismatch-incomplete
personas.description: Infrequent palpitations (roughly once every few months): a 24-hour Holter is the recommended (ideal) monitor type for the palpitations indication itself, but is a poor fit for rare symptom frequency — an event recorder or implantable loop recorder would give far better diagnostic yield. The -3 mismatch penalty pulls the score from 8 down to 5 (may-be-appropriate, not usually-not-appropriate), so this engine's distinctive `redirect` recommendation fires from the frequency-mismatch check rather than a query-referrer appropriateness mismatch; several administrative fields are not yet captured — expect may-be-appropriate (score 5) + mismatched + routine + low priority + redirect, completeness below 100.

request.relevantHistory: Intermittent palpitations, occurring roughly once every few months, each lasting a few minutes.

triage.notes: GP requested a standard 24-hour Holter despite the infrequent symptoms; consider an event recorder or implantable loop recorder instead.
